Name: Portraited Changing Skies - Stable
Author: Kanadeyoru
Description:
[center][font=Georgia][size=3][url=https://imgbb.com/][/url][url=https://ibb.co/N1hPFyf][img]https://i.ibb.co/GswLd5G/Logo-Nuvem.png[/img]
[/url]
[/size][/font][/center][font=Georgia][size=3]


[left][url=https://imgbb.com/][/url][url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/yQGJ7Dp/about.png[/img]
[/url][/left]Differently from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19513]Changing Skies[/url], [i]Portraited[/i] Changing Skies only makes changes to the portrait frame background. This means there are no new designs for dialogue box borders with rounded corners and colors that match the current weather. If you want these features, I recommend downloading the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19513]original mod[/url].

This version was created for those who, like me, prefer to maintain the vanilla feel of the interface, with minimal changes and additions.

This is my first mod (and it was also my first attempt at creating pixel art), so please let me know if you encounter any bugs. Additionally, I hope to release compatibility patches for other mods if necessary.



[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/fxgkH7b/features.png[/img][/url]
Besides of course having everything portraited, the mod also includes:
[/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Backgrounds for all weather types (Including windy days).[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Backgrounds for day and night times ([i]Soon[/i] sunset and sunrise too!).[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Backgrounds for some interiors (Currently sewers, qi, mines and indoors).[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Multiple recolors support (More to be added).[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia][center][url=https://imgbb.com/][/url][url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/nn32L2C/ezgif-com-effects.gif[/img][/url][/center]



[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/JRYChv5/special-thanks.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Doragoun/mods][size=3]Doragoun[/size][/url][size=3] for helping me through this process, I recommend everyone to check their profile for other amazing mods!
[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/aerinanxiety/about-me]Aerinanxiety[/url] for speeding up half of all the work with the Overgrown Flowery Interface compatibility![/size][/font]
